name: Scheduled-release and breaking-news latency taking (earnings, macro prints, agency / court decisions, election-night returns, live ceremonies)
one_line: Sweep the resting orders nobody cancelled in the 2-10 s after a scheduled public number prints (FOMC, CPI, payrolls, EPS); the mirror is a calendar cancel module for the owner's own quotes, which are the prey.
maturity: Established but small for Fed decisions and BLS prints (tapes show 3 wallets taking $99k/$20k/$5k at +4-9 s on 16 Sep 2026, ~$5.7k gross taker edge in 10 s across two markets); Established but thin, probably decayed, for earnings ($5.5k realised by the one identifiable specialist since Feb 2026; the March '$32k' claim cannot be matched to a wallet); unscheduled headlines, election night and ceremonies unverified
requires_ai: optional; offline rule compilation (GAAP vs non-GAAP, rounding), never in the release path
edge: Stale resting orders through a scheduled print (reward-farmed Fed books); first informed clips at +4-7 s
capital: <$1k earnings/BLS clips; $5k-$50k to take the Fed; locked 1-2 h
build_time: 2-3 weeks on an existing execution stack; calendar cancel module 2-3 days
opportunity_size: Fed day ~$140k notional / ~$5.7k gross edge in 10 s; CPI + jobs ~$1.1k/month; earnings $0-110 per event; earnings shrinking
expected_results: wallets: $44.0k realised (macro, 10 weeks), $5.5k (earnings, 7 months); solo guess $0-300/month plus $300-1,500 per Fed day if first
competition: 3 wallets take the Fed in 6 s, 20 in 10 s; 40-43 wallets on CPI within 30 s
flag: none for public-information speed; grey on newswire/X terms; MNPI prohibited (file 30)
validate: Paper-trade the October calendar with own L2 recorder; pass if parse time beats T+4 s Fed / T+6 s BLS and paper edge > $300
top_risk: Winner-take-all race; a 500 ms wire already lost in Q1 2026
solo_fit_reason: The taker side is a source-latency race with a few hundred dollars of prey per event outside eight Fed days a year; the maker-side calendar cancel is cheap, evidenced and directly protects the owner's LP and reward bots.
speed_class: latency-sensitive: decided in 0.3-5 s source-to-order; venue clock is 1 s
min_capital: ~$2k; hosting exceeds a normal month's edge below it
capacity_ceiling: resting size at the print: ~$5.7k edge on a Fed day, ~$0.7k CPI, ~$100 per earnings event
changes_made: Reconstructed second-by-second tapes for the 16 Sep Fed decision, 11 Sep CPI, 4 Sep payrolls/unemployment and six earnings releases from the Data API; measured capacity, timing and gross edge per event.
Profiled the repeat sniper wallets (macro specialist $44.0k realised since Jul 2026; earnings specialist $5.5k since Feb 2026).

Verified via /clob-markets that earnings, Fed, CPI, daily BTC and daily SPX markets carry no taker-delay flag (only hourly BTC markets do); earnings, CPI and Fed markets carry the 0.05 economics fee, not 0.04 finance.
Documented that Kalshi closes CPI 5 min and payrolls 1 min before the print and lists no earnings series, so Polymarket is the only venue with a post-print window.

Cite-check pass (2026-09-28 16:12-16:20 UTC, all 22 sources re-fetched or re-queried): Fed, CPI, payrolls and unemployment tapes re-run with inclusive windows; the winning Fed market's gross taker edge corrected from ~$1.5k to ~$2.5k (SELL-NO takers were undercounted) and the Fed-day total from ~$4.7k to ~$5.7k; trade and wallet counts at +10 s updated (35/20 and 28/16); the claim of a live liquidity-reward config on the Nike earnings market could not be reproduced and was replaced by the two $1,000/day pools on the live Fed October markets; the maker-mirror module quantified ($0.69 of pool per minute out of band vs ~4c per share given up at the print); the '$32k vs $5.5k' earnings comparison reworded because the two cannot be shown to be the same wallet; the 'offset cap 1,000' claim removed (2,500 trades reachable; /v2/trades takes condition + start/end); Massive's Benzinga partner news dataset ($99/month) added; IMDEA source description corrected (crypto microbets excluded, SII trade dataset, 17 Oct 2025 - 29 Mar 2026); $1k row cut to -$65 to +$100.
open_doubts: The Q1 2026 earnings leader's data path (sub-500 ms) is unknown and its wallet was never identified; the Aug-Sep tapes show first prints at +2-4 s, so either it left or the prey is gone.
Data API trade timestamps are 1-s match times; sub-second ordering within the +4-7 s pack cannot be resolved.
The 0x2f63 wallet's $77k realised PnL mixes geopolitics deadline trades with release sniping; its release-only share is unknown.
Election-night and ceremony variants rest on press anecdotes (CNBC snippet, HTTP 403) only.

The writer's 16:02 UTC reading of a live rewards config on the Nike earnings market could not be reproduced at 16:16 UTC; reward-farmed resting size is evidenced on the Fed October markets, not on earnings markets.
